model_annotation: The image displays a nested donut chart illustrating the relative shares in percent for various categories in the years 2014 and 2021, with the inner circle representing 2014 and the outer circle representing 2021. The chart is divided into 14 distinct categories. There is no separate legend; instead, category labels and the 2021 percentage values are positioned outside the outer ring, connected to their respective segments by thin lines, while the 2014 percentage values are placed directly inside the inner ring's segments. The text color of the numerical values matches the color of their corresponding slices. The segments are separated by thin white borders, with no slices visually emphasized through explosion or offset, and they do not appear to be ordered by size. Starting from the top and moving clockwise, the categories and their respective outer (2021) and inner (2014) percentages are: "Kultur" in blue (2.2% outer, 2.4% inner); "Sport/Erholung" in dark grey (3.6% outer, 4.1% inner); "Wohnungswesen" in light green (7.2% outer, 8.4% inner); "Abwasserentsorgung" in light blue (7.8% outer, 10.2% inner); "Abfallwirtschaft" in purple (3.4% outer, 4.0% inner); "Stromversorgung" in bright green (8.9% outer, 4.2% inner); "Gasversorgung" in black (1.5% outer, 1.3% inner); "Wasserversorgung" in medium blue (8.8% outer, 11.8% inner); "Kombinierte Versorgung" in light purple (5.5% outer, 6.2% inner); "Übrige Versorgung" in dark red (1.3% outer, 1.4% inner); "Verkehr" in grey (3.7% outer, 4.4% inner); "Wirtschaftsförderung" in a second light green segment (4.7% outer, 6.2% inner); "Kliniken" in a second light blue segment (3.2% outer, 4.5% inner); and "Übrige" in light grey (38.1% outer, 31.1% inner).
